algorithms.title: Suspected Biological Event (EMS)
steps: PPE by syndrome: respiratory + rash/bleeding → airborne + contact (N95/PAPR, gown, gloves, eye protection).
Source control: surgical mask on the patient.
Limit crew contact; avoid aerosol-generating procedures unless necessary.
Notify medical control and public health; pre-alert the hospital.
Decontaminate the ambulance per agent guidance; doff PPE with a spotter.

algorithms.title: Radiological Incident (EMS)
steps: Approach upwind; use dosimeters; minimize time, maximize distance, use shielding.
Triage and treat life threats in standard PPE (gloves, gown, N95/mask, eye protection).
Remove patient clothing (bag/label); gently wash skin and wounds; cover wounds.
Note time of vomiting (dose estimate); avoid eating/drinking/smoking in the area.
Notify hospital: contaminated vs exposed; numbers.
Survey responders and equipment before leaving; follow turn-back values.
